description: Waits for several orders at once (up to 12 ids, up to 50 s) and returns the finished ones with their results and the ones still running. Use it after generate with wait false, e.g. four pictures placed one after another, then one wait for all of them. If some are still running, call it again with their ids after poll_after_seconds; never order them again.

ids.description: Order ids from generate or list_generations.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait at most, 0–50 s (default 50); 0 just looks.

name: wait_for_generations
title: Wait for generations
